How do you approach the process of selecting tracks for your DJ sets or performances?
I like to start my sets with something nostalgic but also eclectic at the same time. For my live streaming or mix, I like to make a curated selection. When I play in the club, I always follow the vibe and the flow of the crowd. The more energetic I feel, the more I like to play with experimental, dark, and spicy sounds, but also bright and energetic. Let's say I would like to be able to transport my sound into an erotic and exciting world.
My sets feel like late-night cinema; magnetic, moody, and emotionally charged.

Roberta Deflorio

Roberta Deflorio is an emerging Italian, Berlin-based, DJ. From electrifying debuts in Tbilisi to rocking sets across London, Milan, Barcelona, Athens, Antwerp, Berlin and Rome. CYRK

CYRK is a live show and studio duo born from the visions of two Berlin-based producers, Samy Goossens and Pascal Hetzel. They have been busy playing around the world as a live act, bringing their Detroit-influenced blend of techno, acid and electro, as well as their love for all things italo to some of the world’s best dancefloors. From their extensive hardware set up, they fuse tough, eyes-down grooves with propulsive basslines and restrained, melodic atmospheres. Their studio work has led to acclaimed releases on Running Back, Rawax, Burial Soil, Vakant, Avoidant, Dred, Lone Romantic, International Chrome, Discos Atonicos and their own Time Zero label, as well as remixes for Fabrice Lig, DJ Hell and T99. In September 2021 they released their debut album, ‘Escaping Earth’ on Muallem’s (of-Blitz-club-fame) label, Childhood to much international acclaim. There is more in the pipeline: an electronica/ambient album, two very special collaborative releases, which will be announced in due time.

What is the best advice you've been given in your career?
The best advice I've ever been given is to always stay true to myself and to make music out of passion not for validation, not for trends, and definitely not to please others. It reminded me that the most powerful art comes from a place of authenticity. When you create for yourself first, your sound is more honest, more raw, and more meaningful. It's easy to get lost in expectations, whether it's from the industry, listeners, or even yourself. But that advice taught me that I should never lose the spark that made me start in the first place. Passion has to stay at the center of everything. As long as I’m making music that resonates with me, that I believe in, I know I’m on the right path and if others connect with it, that’s an amazing bonus.
Dive into my Hör Picks diverse electronic gems inside.

Carl Bergé

Made in Bochum. Shaped in Melbourne. Based in Berlin. Well-known for his dramaturgic approach to DJ sets, Carl Bergé mastered the craft of cross-genre performances with a strong build up over time, leading him to a residency at the internationally renowned HÖR Berlin radio station. While House music remains at the core of his sound, Carl’s productions combine his passion for deep, pacy and unconventional music with support on his releases from icons such as Skin On Skin amongst others. Although he grew up in West-Germany, Carl’s passion for electronic music ignited in ever-sunny Australia, where he spent 12-hour farmwork shifts listening to early releases of Mall Grab, DJ Boring and Ross From Friends on repeat. Further down the road, iconic places like SASH, Revolver Upstairs or Naarm’s infamous Breakfast Club shaped his taste and understanding of electronic music. After relocating to Berlin, he founded label and event series [coconut.concepts] and quickly started playing in the well-known underground club scene of the so called „Techno Capital“. Besides a variety of festivals such as Amsterdam’s infamous ADE, he played international debuts across UK, Spain, Portugal, Austria, Switzerland and Nicaragua as well as many german top tiers like Hamburg’s PAL, Cologne’s Gewölbe or Berlin's usual suspects such as RSO, Watergate, Sisyphos and Renate to name a few. Within his young career he already shared line-ups with established and upcoming talent including Gabrielle Kwarteng, DJ Heartstring, Ogazón, Bashkka, Lovefoxy and CRYME.

Johannes Albert

Accomplished as a certified Hit-Producer and DJ hailing from Berlin, Johannes Albert has left an indelible mark on the global dance music scene. For the past decade, he has steered the ship at the Frank Music label, solidifying his presence as a stalwart in Berlin's nightclubs and captivating audiences worldwide. Johannes Albert's magnetic DJ reputation has catapulted him to stages from London to Tokyo, Augsburg to Cape Town. This is no surprise, given his impressive dual role as the head of his labels, Frank Music and Fine. His musical contributions extend beyond, gracing imprints like Live At Robert Johnson and Permanent Vacation. Known for eclectic mixes and a range of genre-spanning aliases, Johannes effortlessly infuses modern disco euphoria with a touch of acid, seamlessly blending classics and displaying an open mind towards genres, even embracing current rave revivals. Hailing from the enchanting region of Franconia near Würzburg, Johannes's journey began with a fascination for the house and disco sounds of the time, evolving into a deep exploration of techno, acid, electro, italo, and beyond. Endowed with the essential DJ quality of amiability, propelling him from hometown clubs to a staple of the German scene. Frank Music, initially a platform for Johannes Albert's productions, has birthed four solo albums, including the ambient masterpiece "Spessart." Tracks like "Endorphin Refill" and "Fountain Of Youth" have become anthems, with contributions from artists such as I:Cube, Lauer, Fred P, Ladymonixx, Boris Dlugosch, David Jackson &amp; Gerd Janson. Meanwhile, Fine, managed alongside Tilman, is firmly rooted in House Music, where a simple sample and beat can set the dance floor ablaze. In 2024, Frank Music releases "Moon IV," a collaborative album with Iron Curtis, showcasing their moody material. Johannes Albert, often associated with summery, uplifting mixes, surprises with his versatility, evident in remixes for Riva Starr &amp; Mark Broom, Alan Dixon, andhim, Super Flu, Keinemusik &amp; Catz ‘N Dogz. Having found kindred spirits in the many hotspots of Berlin, Johannes is one of the very few DJs who can equally adjust to the many floors of the city, being a regular at Watergate, Tresor, Sisyphos, Else, about blank, Renate and the likes. Embracing an 'anything goes, super fun' approach, he considers Berlin the perfect home base to explore his myriad influences, ensuring a box of fully road-tested tricks for every club and festival adventure.

What do you consider to be the most fulfilling aspect of being a DJ or musician?
The most fulfilling part of being a DJ is the unique connection I get to create with the crowd through music. It’s an energy exchange that makes every set feel special. On top of that, traveling, meeting new people, and forming unforgettable memories along the way makes it even more rewarding!
There should always be music, no matter what happens.

Viscerale

Born in Hamburg and based in Berlin since 2011, Viscerale has a classical background in piano and found her passion to select the music for the right moment since she was young. Her first electronical mixtapes appeared around 2015 and officially started DJing in clubs in October 2017. She played in several countries including the US, was holding a residency at Ved Siden Af in Copenhagen, and is a regular in Berlin Club´s like Säule (Berghain). Driven by strong emotions and influenced by various genres from Techno to Trance and Hardcore. Her journeys are seeking high energy levels in a playful way with suprising twists.

ÜBERKIKZ

ÜBERKIKZ combines driving kicks, tooly synths, and tribal and folkloric elements into a hypnotic journey. With each kick, she tells stories that resonate deeply, encouraging a confrontation with one's origins. Free from thought, almost instinctively, her sets are a call to surrender to the moment and experience all these raw emotions in its purest form. At the heart of her sets lies the belief that we all share a common origin — beyond nationality, culture, gender or sexuality. Music is the universal bond that unites us, and this is the essence ÜBERKIKZ aims to express through her art: the power of rhytms to bring us together as a community and remind us of the unity of all humanity.

What keeps you passionate about DJing?
For me, DJing is all about energy, connection, and those unforgettable moments on the dancefloor. Hearing a truly great DJ and feeling how the energy in the room comes alive and connects everyone always reminds me why I love what I do. A few weeks ago at Panorama Bar, Jane Fitz closed with one of the most mesmerizing sets I’ve ever heard—it left me completely recharged. The way music brings people together and creates these powerful experiences is what keeps me passionate and inspired.
Everything real is felt, not just seen.

Nicole

Born in Batumi and based in Kyiv Nicole has been immersed in music from a young age. The Georgian artist and producer attended music school as a child and was a drummer in a band. Guided by music as a creative medium, she started her career at the age of 17 as part of a duo named Body Thrills. After going solo, Nicole soon discovered her personal approach to DJing. Since then, she has played her energetic and emotive sets in most of the clubs in her own country and made strong appearances on the European scene. Nicole’s style is impossible to be framed as her sets are shaped by the energy she receives from the dancefloor. She equally enjoys both old-school acid techno and intelligent minimal sounds. Since her performance on Boiler Room in famed nightclub Bassiani to celebrate its reopening following the rave protests against the raids and shutdowns of Tbilisi’s clubs that gained worldwide media attention in 2018, Nicole has been referred to as one of Georgia’s leading DJs and producers. Not content with just DJing, Nicole was also working as a promoter at Tbilisi’s legendary art space and nightclub, Cafe Gallery. 2020 was a year of accomplishments for Nicole as her talents didn’t go unnoticed by prominent DJs and producers beyond Georgia’s shores. She released her debut solo EP Inside on Marco Shuttle’s techno label, Eerie Records. Her track ‘Luna’ was also featured on Nina Kraviz’s first compilation album Hot Steel - a project that was started during the pandemic to support up-and-coming artists - released via Kraviz’s label трип (pronounced 'trip').

Loa Szala

Unquestionably assured and elevated sounds from an artist in the ascendancy, Loa Szala blends stripped back but propulsive bleeps and breaks, hiding in rare undiscovered corners of atmospheric Techno, Progressive, Trance and Electro, with a seamless natural feel. Never rushed, her fine touch and captivating selections fold into a deeply inviting style, rewarding her audiences with a rich flow of records that are full of rumbling presence, finesse, and simmering energy, yet feel personal in every turn. Formerly based in both Poland and Japan, Loa has scoured the globe for underground sounds since 2014, and is now calling another vibrant 24-hour city her home: London. Already with some of the capital’s most prestigious venues under her belt, including a well-deserved residency with thriving international party-starters, Alien Communications, many of the city’s most tasteful critics and clubgoers have increasingly drawn their attention to her quietly captivating performances. Loa sets out across Europe and Worldwide this year on a series of international dates, bringing her enticing, contemporary sounds to a dancefloor near you very soon.

Marcel Fengler

Everyone's fate is made of many tales. Although our own destiny might be dwelling in our breast, it also takes strong convictions and the courage to challenge yourself. DJ, producer and label manager Marcel Fengler is the best example that talent isn’t just a matter of luck, but the will to believe in your own passions while constantly developing them. Today, Fengler has not only been quoted as „one of the finest techno DJs“ (Resident Advisor), he has earned international respect for his „well-crafted body of production work“ (FACT) introducing his unique and „multi-faceted personality“ (Electronic Beats). While growing up, he was first fascinated by the hip-hop culture, breakdance, and graffiti art, Fengler’s interest shifted towards techno music and the art of DJing after the Berlin wall came down. As a vinyl nerd he began playing records during the early nineties. By witnessing Claude Young mixing with three record players, Fengler followed his path merging both hearts in his chest: turntablism and techno. Carried away by the magic and the togetherness of the first hardcore and trance raves in such clubs like E-Werk or Tresor, he organized his own parties in his hometown Fürstenwalde. Over the last two decades, Fengler developed a versatile and dynamic style of DJing that made him one of the first resident DJs of Berlin’s infamous Berghain / Panorama Bar in 2005. With his impressive intuition for the very moment, Fengler is capable of changing pace, atmosphere, and energy reacting to the mood on the dance floor: whether industrial-drenched hardness, broken beats, gloomy dubs or melodic and funky grooves – next to his inimitable instinct, Fengler draws from a varied repertoire. The approach of allowing to drift away within the momentum also applies to his first singles as a producer on such labels like Ostgut Ton and Mote Evolver. His debut album „Fokus“ (2013), in particular, was a statement of his ambitious claim, awarding his own tracks with emotional densities as well as unexpected contrasts. Bringing together both his melodic groove and beat tracks and his straighter cuts, he founded his own imprint Index Marcel Fengler (IMF) in 2011 – a platform that not only continues evolving his timeless techno approach but represents a creative center introducing new and young talents. A logical step for an artist who’s always interested in looking beyond his own nose represented by his project DIN, the mutual collaboration with Philipp Sollmann (Efdemin), for the contemporary dance project „Masse“ of the Staatsballett Berlin. In 2018 his moniker AZUR was born in order to give his melodic side in own identity while productions and DJ sets as Marcel Fengler sticks on its roots of raw and rough techno flavour. As a DJ and producer, Marcel Fengler stands for imposing surprises and the appeal of variety. For him, techno is both unconditional passion as well as an essential part of his identity. He’s not bound to a linear or one-dimensional sound, instead, he’s constantly seeking for new ways to express his emotional storytelling skills. His willingness to challenge himself and to stay curious, while establishing changes as his secret persistence, is showing his true vision of techno which makes Marcel Fengler to one of the today’s most exciting electronic artists in these days.

Umwelt

As an experienced DJ and producer hailing from the underground rave & techno scenes of the 90’s, Umwelt is a truly rare underground artist and one of the most important and prolific electronic producers. Author of an important discography including on his own Rave Or Die and New Flesh Records labels, his productions play the card of a specific and dystopian electro-techno sound. He always delivers a fierce, dark and cinematographic music at the crossroads between the classics and an assumed modernity. His last techno album released on Monnon Black "Dead Eyes Society" (2022) is the perfect illustration of his huge ability of bringing people all together in different moods. MYSTERY KID

Un vent de révolution souffle sur la dark disco. En effet, Mystery Kid ne rentre décidément dans aucune case. Cette DJ et productrice à double facettes repousse toujours plus les BPM de la dark disco, naviguant entre italo musclée, ebm teintée de rock et des kicks break percussifs. Après avoir écumé les grands rendez-vous régionaux incontournables en 2023 tels que le Made Festival (Rennes) et Astropolis (Brest), Mystery Kid part rapidement à la conquête de Paris en se produisant notamment aux festivals We Love Green et Madame Loyal, au fameux club Badaboum, à l'iconique Sacré et en décrochant une résidence à Rinse Fm. Toujours avide de partage, elle a désormais son émission chez Disco Suicide (Berlin) et fait partie du club Radio Vacarme (Bruxelles). Mystery Kid definitely doesn't fit into any box. This dual-faceted DJ and producer began with her first track, “Black Sheep” released on Nubians of Plutonia Records (IT) without any compromise : a melodic symphony, a big dark voice and a strange break kick. After this, she signed on Paco Tyson Records (FR) with two tracks “GTA Cruise” and “Kitkat Anthem”, rocked too by her love for the mix of sounds. She also released on labels such as Femnoises Records (ESP) with a special vocal collaboration with Miss Zagato. Follow this little alien and enter in her dual dark universe with synth waves and rock vibes, where percussive break and EBM merge harmoniously.

Subb-an

Subb-an is an electronic music artist from Birmingham, UK. His DJ sets seamlessly blend deep, groovy basslines with hypnotic rhythms, creating a captivating sonic experience. Releases on esteemed labels include One Records, Spectral Sound and Crosstown Rebels. Subb-an has solidified his status as a producer of exceptional talent and vision and has worked with Mathew Jonson, Seth Troxler, Enzo Siraguza and Tom Trago. As a producer Subb-an has garnered widespread support from a roster of influential DJs including; Ricardo Villalobos, Sonja Moonear, Peach, Tini, Saoirse, Job Jobse, Sedef Adasi, Chris Stussy, Priku, Laurent Garnier, Shanti Celeste, Peggy Gou, and Anotr. His live performances have left an indelible mark and he's made appearances at DC10, Fabric, and Glastonbury. Recent standout gigs at events like Houghton and Sunwaves attest to his continued influence. Anticipate forthcoming releases on labels like Yoyaku, Subb-an’s personal imprint ‘Sub Series’ and Thomas Melchoir’s 'My King Is Light,' ensuring an exciting trajectory for this luminary in the global electronic music scene.

Eònan

There aren’t many black techno producers / DJ’s in Berlin these days but Eònan is definitely one of them. Since a few years he is creating his own sound signature which is dark like his skin but deep and drifty like his mind. By himself he would describe his music as sci-fi-techno but he doesn’t take himself too serious with that. His style is definitely atmospheric, hypnotic and deeply reflecting the ups and downs in life. To understand Eònan’s identity it’s helpful to spot the light on where he comes from. Born and raised in Germany he pretty early got infected by techno music from artists like Surgeon, Jeff Mills, Takkyu Ishino or Cari Lekebusch just to drop a few famous names from the 90’s. Nevertheless these kind of artists had a big influence on Eònan’s musical development. It’s important to mention that he also made a huge journey through different genres that reflect in his music as well. All that creates an interesting sound signature that catches more and more fans in the scene. As a DJ he likes to play at a tearing pace, always with a certain groove and intelligent synth sounds rather than choosing narrowed and too simple tracks for his sets. In Eònan’s opinion techno is a universal language that speaks to us like it comes from a far out and foreign galaxy. Just listen to his new releases to find out more about that...

Lucinee

An electrical charge runs through everything Lucinee transmits. Her productions and DJ sets bristle with peak-time urgency — a rush of volatile synth lines and thunderous drums wrangled from hardware exploration. These sparks can easily ignite huge spaces — festival arenas, the great techno institutions of the world — but they also carry subtlety and balance which looks for something deeper than the one-dimensional banger. Her respected position within the techno scene is well earned, having invested herself in the fundamentals of club culture on her way to holding down a long-standing residency at iconic Hamburg club PAL. This close connection with one space formed a foundation for her consistent presence on the scene, making notable appearances for Boiler Room in Warsaw and at Berghain’s fabled Säule along the way. Lucinee’s productions serve as a natural extension of her open approach to DJing— vibrant jams comfortably housed on labels from Berlin institution BPitch through to EXHALE and Union Trance Mission just to name a few. In her hands, the tenets of classic trance and techno are handled with an exacting poise, drawing on their immersive, psychoactive power to create a trip as subtle as it is impactful. Across all aspects of her creativity, Lucinee matches an inquisitive spirit with a dedicated work ethic. It’s precisely why she’s rightly recognised as an electrifying force in the contemporary techno scene.

Franz Scala

Franz Scala’s sets are as diverse as the music he curates as label head of Slow Motion. Weaving smoothly between Italian Dance, Psychedelic Disco and Proto House, Franz quickly turns the dance floor into a vignette-tainted retro nostalgia rave fueled only by his music. Born in Italy and now a resident of Berlin for a decade Franz has his roots in noise rock and elettronica but was led by the record collectors passion into acquiring a taste for modern and not so modern dance floor music. He frequently inspires dancers in clubs all over Europe with his eclectic blend of spacey House, New Wave, Italo and Acid speckled with hints of Electro and Chicago House. Aside from producing on his own imprint, he has releases on World Unknown, Bordello A Parigi, Bahnsteig 23, Tusk Wax, Mechatronica or Discodromo´s Cocktail d’Amore Music. Franz is link to many events around the german capital such as the monthly Wrong Era, Italian Dance Wave and Italorama night in Panorama Bar, Magic Waves or New Dance Fantasy Festival. Beside long time collaboration with Sameheads he is regular dj at Griessmuhle and Salon zur Wilden Renate. In 2013 he joined Dimitri SoEmotional in the “Studio Luce” project

What is the best advice you've been given in your career?
Don’t get thrown off by what others are doing or what’s currently trending. Focus on what you want to create, on the music that inspires you and sparks something inside you. Otherwise, you might lose the joy in what you love.
Never stop wanting to grow.

Krackk

Krackk is founder and resident of the Dortmund-based Party Baby Love. With a passion for music that runs deep, she is dedicated to supporting upcoming artists and pushing boundaries with her own uplifting sound. Inspired by the 90s but with one eye on the future, Krackk’s signature sound is a unique blend of old-school and modern techno, trance, hardgroove and acid. It’s unexpected and provides high NRG on the dancefloor. So, let yourself be surprised.

Local Suicide

The history of the DJ & producer duo and couple Local Suicide stretches back over a decade to the year 2008. Since meeting, Munich-born Brax Moody and Thessaloniki native Vamparela have collaborated together on various projects, all culminating in the conception of Local Suicide in Berlin. Local Suicide’s distinctive sound, is an energetic fusion of new wave, EBM, post disco and dark techno that they themselves have given the name technodisco, while Beatport declared them as one of the key figures in the uprising dark disco scene. Their DJ career has carried them to all four corners of the world, whipping crowds into a frenzy at Lollapalooza, Melt!, ADE, Off Sonar, Festival Forte, Berlin Festival and almost every club the German capital has to offer. Their live cuts have been honed to perfection with years of shows alongside the very best in the scene, even being invited by New Order to warm up for their live performance. This hectic schedule has taken them across Europe, Asia, North Africa, South America and the United States. With solo & collaborative releases with Curses, Theus Mago, Lena Platonos, Hard Ton, The Hidden Cameras, Rodion, Alejandro Paz, Thomass Jackson, Skelesys, Franz Matthews & more on labels such as Bordello A Parigi, Multi Culti, Duro, Ombra INTL, Lumière Noire, Eskimo, AEON, Ransom Note & TAU the duo had numerous releases reaching the top 10 iTunes, Beatport & Juno charts and had massive editorial playlist support by Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Amazon Music and Deezer. Local Suicide has had a stunning amount of press coverage from leading mags like DJ Mag UK/IT/US/LA/ES, Mixmag, FAZE, Groove, TRAX, Time Out, Tsugi, XLR8R & Rolling Stone and has played themselves in Fett & Fett, a series broadcasted on the biggest german national TV station ZDF in which their musical productions were featured extensively as well. In 2021 the powerhouse launched their own label Iptamenos Discos where they recently released their critically acclaimed debut album ‘Eros Anikate’ among others. In 2022 the duo also revealed their new live band project Dina Summer with Kalipo with which they released their debut album ‘Rimini’ on Audiolith Records. The LP got praised by German magazines such as Der Spiegel, Musikexpress, Musikwoche, Kulturnews, Sonic Seducer and was featured as album of the week on Sunshine Live & Laut.

Is there a specific message or emotion that you strive to convey through your music?
I strive to create a journey that is similar to all the contradictory emotions we experience in life - a journey where in the end people have danced, smiled, cried and fucked. And most important I love to surprise because who doesn't love a good surprise?

Anna Logic

Anna Logic's mixes are genrefluid: somewhere between Disco and Gabber. Having a playful way of breaking down boundaries with contrasts and mixed feelings - jumping between soft and hard, old and new, fun and serious. Some of the genres that influence Anna Logic the most are: Acid House, Hard Trance, Electro, Hard House, Breaks, Hard Dance and Classic Trance. Anna Logic has a constant desire to keep things fresh, combined with an unapologetically high standard when it comes to track selection.

How do you balance your personal life with your demanding schedule as a DJ/musician?
I’m very bad at balancing these 2 things, because once you’re getting into music, it’s hard to stop, even I’m scheduling special time for it I can’t keep up to it to not get burn out, I always wanna do something more, learn more, read more, produce more.

Skungal

Skungal is a DJ and music producer from Ukraine, known for her energetic sets full of groovy sounds. She specializes in Techno, Acid, Breaks, hard house, hard groove, and hard techno. Skungal has performed in various clubs and events across Ukraine, Poland, Spain, Germany and Belgium. including popular clubs such as RSO., OXI, AEDEN, Re:mise, Renate, Fitzroy, Suicide Club, Undertage Club, Recede Club, AVA, and Mahalla. Her music is a perfect blend of different genres and an expression of her passion and dedication to music.
